en: A black-and-white winter scene showing an old intercity bus stopped on a snow-covered rural road. The bus has roof racks and large side windows, with a sign painted on the side indicating its route. A person in a coat and cap, holding a bag or canister, stands by the roadside near the bus. In the background are snowy fields, scattered wooden fences, and a low building, suggesting a remote northern countryside.
